Redcontent moved to DocumentationPortal <https://docs.example.com/reference/resource-667>

### PipelineHub UI support for Backup/Restore/Delete backup

PipelineHub supports backup, restore and delete from UI. Support 2 backups for EnvironmentService pods

* In case you encounter issues with Backup/Restore, see Self-Triaging page for [Backup/Restore](https://docs.example.com/reference/resource-668)

### PipelineHub UI support for Restore

PipelineHub supports two forms of restore

1. Restoring at same version as the pods version. This is done using a POD Backups available at that version
2. Restoring to n-1 version. This is only available when the pod has been successfully upgrade. Once the upgrade is complete and if the user wishes to go back to n-1 version, he/she can do a n-1 restore.

### PipelineHub refresh button for Backup/Restore job's

The status one off for backup / restore jobs appears under POST_PROVISIONING_ACTIONS

* Users can get the status of the backup or restore at any point of time, need not wait till the job is COMPLETED
* Some backup and restore jobs have to be resumed from JC console and the job continues to run. In such cases users can also refresh the status from PipelineHub UI with "Refresh" circle arrow button.

### Hard delete the pod backup UI

* Backup delete is now linked to actual JC job which hard deletes backup and frees up space.
* After selecting "Delete Backup" there will be a new preflight ID created to track backup delete

1. 1. As you guys know, there are multiple jobs that does purge like “direct” purge, manifest DO purge, manifest carb, ArmC, etc
1. 1. 1. Note that since a label DO, can be referenced in any other label (due to inc build) we don’t purge per label. But we purge in a consolidation way where we make sure we purge a DO only when its “orphaned”.
1. 1. For each jobs run, any artifact that gets deleted, is backed up in the object storage.
	2. Additionally, a metadata file is generated, per purge run, as to what was deleted.

**Restore:**

1. 1. When a restore is executed, we read ALL the metadata files, produced by different kind of purges.
	2. Then, for a given snapshot, we go and restore all the arifacts with that snapshot version.
	3. Then the SOL label (workspacecli) is also attempted.
	4. Once the restore is done a summary email is sent.
1. 1. 1. In the email, if any DO restore is missed, based on the metadata file, it is mentioned.
